verdict.rationale: AgentMail's API reference documents an official Python SDK, and the homepage shows a JS/TS client call (`await client.inboxes.create()`), which implies a JavaScript SDK. A community user independently praised the dashboard popovers that show SDK examples, corroborating that the SDKs exist and are surfaced to developers. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference or install documentation, explicit naming of the supported language set beyond Python, and hands-on reports of building with the SDKs.
